facts.fact: 关着它的黄铜笼子崭新发亮，几乎从地板通到天花板。
facts.anchor: The brass cage that contained it was sparkling new

facts.fact: 但它终究是笼子，永远都会是笼子。
facts.anchor: But it was still a cage. It would always be a cage.

facts.fact: 久到附魔师学会用它的血制出无效化血清。
facts.anchor: Long enough for Enchanters to learn how to make a nullification serum from its blood.

facts.fact: 我一周前就摸到了作战室，那会儿我们正在标该炸的地方。
facts.anchor: I found the war room a sennight ago while we were marking suitable areas to blow up.

facts.fact: 那一直是她丈夫的计划。
facts.anchor: That had been her husband’s plan all along.
There’s spectral blood in there as well.

facts.fact: 于是我偷了一只狼形小艇，向西航行。
facts.anchor: So I stole a wolf coracle and sailed west.

facts.fact: 我儿子的名字叫尼桑德罗斯。
